 Oral Judgment

These appeals are filed by the appellants/claimants challenging the judgment and award dated 09.12.2013 passed in MVC.Nos.127/2009 and 129/2009 by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge & MACT-XII,
Madhugiri, for seeking enhancement of compensation.
The factum of accident, injuries suffered by the claimants and liability fastened on the respondents are not in dispute.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.

In MFA.No.7064/2014, from the medical evidence on record, the claimant sustained the following injuries:
"a) Lacerated wound over the parietal Sangeetha vs Ranganatha Rao on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49530819/
3 b) Tenderness over the right shoulder and dislocation of patella c) Abrasion over the right thigh area 5.

The Tribunal has awarded the compensation under various heads as follows:
Pain and suffering Rs.10,000/-

Medical expenses Rs.29,294/-
 Miscellaneous Rs.12,000/-
 TOTAL Rs.51,294/-
 NC: 2024:KHC:51082 6.

Considering the nature of injuries sustained by the claimant as above stated and the amount of compensation awarded by the Tribunal are found to be on the lesser side as correct parameters are not taken into consideration.

Therefore, it just and proper to award global compensation of Rs.20,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
7. In MFA.No.7065/2014, from the medical evidence on record, the claimant sustained the following injuries:
"a) Compound fracture and proximal phalanx of left great toe b) Lacerated wound present on the left side of interdigits c) Abrasion wound over the left thigh 8.

Therefore, it just and proper to award global compensation of Rs.20,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.

10. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i. MFA.Nos.7064/2014 and 7065/2014 filed by the appellants/claimants are allowed-in-part.
NC: 2024:KHC:51082 ii.

The impugned judgment and award dated 09.12.2013 passed in MVC.No.127/2009 and MVC.No.129/2009 by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge &
MACT-XII, Madhugiri, is hereby modified.
